title: Édgar Ramírez on Venezuela’s Future: “There Are No Good, Viable Options. It’s a Choice of Bad or Worse”
summary: The Venezuelan star discusses the "mix of relief, fear and exhaustion" that has followed the capture of President Nicolás Maduro by the U.S. and how his new film, 'It Would Be Night in Caracas' reckons with 25 years of collapse that have left Venezuela with “no food, no medicine, no future."
